nostr.reason: nostr 0.45 removed the crate-root re-exports (nostr::Event, Keys, PublicKey, Kind, Tag, Filter, EventBuilder, SECP256K1, plus the nostr::secp256k1 and nostr::hashes re-exports); a trial bump on 2026-11-07 failed in buzz-core alone with 55 resolution errors, and nostr is imported by 404 .rs files across 25 workspace crates and the Tauri crate. Upstream block/buzz main still declares nostr 0.44, so migrating here would fork the whole codebase from upstream. Trigger: upstream bumps nostr (arrives with the next sync), or the registry passes 0.45.7.

virtua.reason: Patched dependency: patches/virtua@0.49.3.patch edits the minified lib/index.cjs and lib/index.js and widens the Virtualizer `itemSize` type to accept a per-item function. virtua 0.54.2 restructured those internals and still declares `itemSize?: number` only, so the patch neither applies nor has an upstream equivalent; a rebase means re-implementing the feature inside the scroll engine and re-validating timeline scroll anchoring. Upstream block/buzz main still pins virtua 0.49.3 with the same patch. Trigger: virtua ships function-valued itemSize, or upstream rebases the patch, or the registry passes 0.54.2.
